import numpy as np

# --- Plan ---
# Hammer lies along Y: handle toward +Y, head toward -Y. get_hammer_pose() gives the
# middle of the handle. Keep the hammer horizontal (along Y) throughout, so both
# grippers can grasp the handle from above with fingers closing across X.
# Arm0 grabs the head-side part of the handle (y - 0.05), Arm1 grabs the free
# end-side part (y + 0.05): 10 cm center separation along Y, where the Franka hand
# is thin, giving a collision-free buffer. Handover happens at the midpoint x~0.81
# with the hammer at z = 0.175 (inside the required 0.15-0.20 window).
# Movements are decomposed into pure vertical and pure horizontal translations.

Q0_X = np.array([0.0, 0.707, 0.707, 0.0])   # arm0 facing down, opening along X
Q1_X = np.array([0.0, 0.707, -0.707, 0.0])  # arm1 facing down, opening along X ([0,0,1,0] rotated 90deg about z)

hammer_pos, _ = get_hammer_pose()
hx, hy, hz = float(hammer_pos[0]), float(hammer_pos[1]), float(hammer_pos[2])

HANDOVER_Z = 0.175                 # desired hammer z at handover
X_MID = (0.44 + 1.18) / 2.0        # midpoint between initial gripper positions
Y_SEP = 0.05                       # offset of each grasp from handle middle

grasp0 = np.array([hx, hy - Y_SEP, hz])            # arm0 grasp: handle, toward head side
z_lift = hz + (HANDOVER_Z - hz) + 0.0              # gripper z so hammer center sits at HANDOVER_Z
z_lift = HANDOVER_Z + (grasp0[2] - hz)             # (= HANDOVER_Z since gripper z == hammer center z)
z_travel = max(z_lift, hz + 0.12)                  # clear table while translating

# --- Arm0: pick up hammer ---
open_gripper_arm0()
goto_pose_arm0(grasp0, Q0_X, z_approach=0.12)
close_gripper_arm0()

# lift straight up
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([grasp0[0], grasp0[1], z_travel]), Q0_X)

# translate horizontally to handover point (midpoint between arms)
handover0 = np.array([X_MID, grasp0[1], z_travel])
goto_pose_arm0(handover0, Q0_X)

# set final handover height (hammer center at ~0.175)
handover0 = np.array([X_MID, grasp0[1], z_lift])
goto_pose_arm0(handover0, Q0_X)

# --- Arm1: grasp the handle (free end, +Y side), approaching from above ---
open_gripper_arm1()
grasp1 = np.array([X_MID, grasp0[1] + 2.0 * Y_SEP, z_lift])   # 10 cm along Y from arm0's gripper
goto_pose_arm1(grasp1, Q1_X, z_approach=0.15)
close_gripper_arm1()

# --- Arm0: release and retreat (up first, then back toward its own side) ---
open_gripper_arm0()
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([X_MID, grasp0[1], z_lift + 0.15]), Q0_X)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([0.45, grasp0[1], z_lift + 0.15]), Q0_X)
